card.name: Scattered words in instruction sentences
card.fires_on: No single word type. It fires on scattered words in instructions, such as the start of a brand name after 'resume', 'never', 'for' and 'is'.

modes.label: Resume brand name
modes.description: The first part of a brand name right after the word 'resume' in dose-restart instructions.

modes.label: Injection instructions
modes.description: Words in directions about injection sites or separate supplies.
modes.example: use a different injection site for each injection;<< never>> give injections into areas where the skin is

modes.label: General web text
modes.description: Ordinary words in non-medical text with no shared theme.
modes.example: she stood out from the<< majority>> of artists living there

card.writes: It weakly favours words that start a restriction or exit, and suppresses 'only' and similar words.
card.plain: It responds to a mix of unrelated words, mostly in instructions. No single pattern was found across the passages.
